description: B19-B22 Adapter 实现输入 - Android/iOS/Desktop Adapter合同要求

requirements.mustReturnValue: UnifiedToolResult normalized from Android domain DTOs

conformance.canResolve: Supports(binding) must return true for android_native runtimeType
conformance.validateBinding: Validate Android-specific binding metadata (no raw secrets)
conformance.execute: Delegate to Android Provider via IPC/Bridge
conformance.cancelPropagation: Must support Android cancel -> ctx.Done() propagation
conformance.errorNormalization: Map Android errors to ToolError codes (preserve domainCode)
conformance.health: Report Android Provider health via HealthStatus

requirements.mustReturnValue: UnifiedToolResult normalized from iOS domain DTOs
UnifiedToolResult normalized from desktop domain DTOs

conformanceTestRequirements: binding resolution - verify adapter.Supports() correctly identifies binding
unsupported binding - verify adapter rejects unknown runtime type
adapter lookup - RuntimeAdapterRegistry.Resolve returns correct adapter
context propagation - verify ctx cancellation propagates to provider
error normalization - verify domain errors map to ToolError codes
health - verify Health() returns correct status
duplicate register - verify second register for same RuntimeType conflicts
